chunks: 1569 - And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh narrated from him that he said:
"When you perform salat (prayer), then pray in your sandals if they are tahir (ritually clean), for indeed that is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition)."

key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: the prophetic tradition and normative practice
key_terms.طَاهِرَةً: ritually clean and free from impurity

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in sandals if they are clean?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that performing salat (prayer) in sandals is recommended when they are tahir (ritually clean). It presents this practice as being from the sunnah (prophetic tradition), indicating its legitimacy and merit in worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1569 - It is narrated from Him (Imam Al-Sadiq (as)) through Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah that Imam (as) said:
"If you pray, then pray in your sandals (shoes) if they are clean, for that is from the Sunnah."
